reasoning_content: deegree is a snapshot version, and it's a modified version hosted on gitlab.opencode.de. Let's check whether it can be resolved. I'll try checking the URL of the maven repository of the gitlab project.

action.command:
for url in \
 "https://gitlab.opencode.de/api/v4/projects/622/packages/maven/de/latlon/deegree/deegree-core-commons/3.6.11-SNAPSHOT/maven-metadata.xml" \
 "https://repo.deegree.org/repository/public/de/latlon/deegree/deegree-core-commons/3.6.11-SNAPSHOT/maven-metadata.xml" ; do echo "== $url"; timeout 20 curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" "$url"; done

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "for url in \\\n \"https://gitlab.opencode.de/api/v4/projects/622/packages/maven/de/latlon/deegree/deegree-core-commons/3.6.11-SNAPSHOT/maven-metadata.xml\" \\\n \"https://repo.deegree.org/repository/public/de/latlon/deegree/deegree-core-commons/3.6.11-SNAPSHOT/maven-metadata.xml\" ; do echo \"== $url\"; timeout 20 curl -s -o /dev/null -w \"%{http_code}\\n\" \"$url\"; done", "summary": "Test resolving deegree snapshot artifact"}
